messages:
Anna L: CI: gpu-accelerator-test (cuda-integration) on master is red since 06:22 UTC. Job 86214. Failure during the long_inference_test with a kernel error — pasting tail of the runner log below. Anyone seen this pattern?

Anna L: ```
[2026-03-17 06:22:13] ERROR: GPU kernel.h: kernel launch failed: unspecified launch failure
[2026-03-17 06:22:14] NVRM: Xid 64: GPU has fallen off the bus. GPU 0: GPU-UUID
[2026-03-17 06:22:15] RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 2.1GiB (GPU 0)
```

Sam K: Can you paste the job config / docker image + node it ran on? also last green SHA for that job.

Anna L: job link: https://ci.redwood/86214, image: redwood/ci-gpu:2026-03-12, node: gpu-3.dc1.redwood.internal, last green sha: 8f4c2e9

Mario P: any chance this is a flaky OOM vs a driver/kernel panic? If it's a panic it usually shows Xid 31/13 but Xid 64 is odd. Can you try repro locally on gpu-3 or repro on a different pool?

Anna L: kicked a rerun on gpu-3 first to reproduce. infra-bot: "Re-run requested by @Anna L: job 86214 -> 86215"

infra-bot: "Runner assigned: gpu-3 (node: gpu-3.dc1). Re-run started by @Mario P."

Anna L: rerun (86215) failed faster — OOM during model load and then kernel dropped. Logs now show both "out of memory" and the Xid 64 kernel message.

Misha R: can we bisect the SHA range between 8f4c2e9 (green) and current master a1b2c3d? We should rule out a model/regression first. Use the gpu bisect helper:

Misha R: ```
./ci/scripts/gpu-bisect.sh --start 8f4c2e9 --end a1b2c3d --job long_inference_test --pool gpu-pool-stable
```

Sam K: quick check: can you run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name,memory.total --format=csv` on gpu-3 and on a green node? I suspect a driver mismatch across pools.

Anna L: output from gpu-3 (problematic):
Anna L: ```
driver_version, name, memory.total
525.85.05, NVIDIA A40, 48 MiB
```

Anna L: output from gpu-1 (green node):
Anna L: ```
driver_version, name, memory.total
470.161.03, NVIDIA A40, 48 MiB
```

Sam K: yep — that's the smoking gun. We have divergent driver versions on different runner pools; newer 525 driver is exhibiting a different memory behavior (and sometimes hard faults) with our CUDA 11.8 build.

Ryan G: I'll pin the failing job to gpu-pool-stable temporarily and disable auto-scheduler for the pipeline until infra sorts drivers. Re-running on stable now.

infra-bot: "Job 86216 queued on gpu-pool-stable by @Ryan G"

Anna L: run 86216 on stable passed all tests.

Mario P: great. Next actions: infra needs to align drivers (or we should standardize runner images to include driver check). Also add a presubmit matrix test that prevents scheduling across mixed-driver pools.

Sam K: I'll open a PR to add a presubmit driver-check step and a CI label that forces pool selection when drivers differ. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4382 (WIP).

Misha R: I'll run the bisect on stable pool as backup, but given the driver mismatch it's lower priority.

Anna L: tl;dr: root cause=heterogeneous driver versions (525 vs 470) causing OOM/driver faults on some nodes. Mitigations: pin to stable pool, infra reconcile drivers, add presubmit check + pool-labeling. Thanks all :relieved: :tada:
